SELECT o.`order_id`, nvl(o.total_amount, 0) AS amount
FROM sales.orders o
WHERE date_add(o.order_date, 30) >= '2026-11-01'
LIMIT 100
SELECT order_id, tag FROM sales.order_lines LATERAL VIEW explode(tags) t AS tag
SELECT order_id FROM sales.orders TIMESTAMP AS OF date_sub(current_date(), 1)
